title: Acyclic Organic Compounds
statementMd:
You are given a tree $*T*$ with $*n*$ vertices (numbered $1$ through $*n*$) and a letter in each vertex. The tree is rooted at vertex $1$.

Let's look at the subtree $*T*_{*v*}$ of some vertex $*v*$. It is possible to read a string along each simple path starting at $*v*$ and ending at some vertex in $*T*_{*v*}$ (possibly $*v*$ itself). Let's denote the number of **distinct** strings which can be read this way as ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd208c8f291ac26d2c1afe01926632d52a3b9c7f.png).

Also, there's a number $*c*_{*v*}$ assigned to each vertex $*v*$. We are interested in vertices with the maximum value of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f502ea3f6cf16bce416fd43b9c9bb79980ffa382.png).

You should compute two statistics: the maximum value of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f502ea3f6cf16bce416fd43b9c9bb79980ffa382.png) and the number of vertices $*v*$ with the maximum ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f502ea3f6cf16bce416fd43b9c9bb79980ffa382.png).

## Input

The first line of the input contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 300 000$) — the number of vertices of the tree.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*c*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$).

The third line contains a string $*s*$ consisting of $*n*$ lowercase English letters — the $*i*$-th character of this string is the letter in vertex $*i*$.

The following $*n* - 1$ lines describe the tree $*T*$. Each of them contains two space-separated integers $*u*$ and $*v*$ ($1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$) indicating an edge between vertices $*u*$ and $*v*$.

It's guaranteed that the input will describe a tree.

## Output

Print two lines.

On the first line, print ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ca61e8ad8b32ae7f5adbad10109a51bd42f3ab4.png) over all $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$.

On the second line, print the number of vertices $*v*$ for which ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6604043b6c7f1f01412e02c2d1b462b73786da81.png).

## Note

In the first sample, the tree looks like this:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e73c5960bdba5494ac0d005fdbeceb58e8011859.png)

The sets of strings that can be read from individual vertices are:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cdd20e7ec866e6f991ca2f90e08792408c889db7.png)

Finally, the values of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14691bbbb07694ceb84c7c73aa24a29ecfcb9e6b.png) are:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/984bc948f68a2c35f75db857f62c005dcf9206d7.png)

In the second sample, the values of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58314b06b4c754bc3d1eeee1a5f0140ed5645015.png) are $(5, 4, 2, 1, 1, 1)$. The distinct strings read in $*T*_{2}$ are ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/072d38bb85cddb83248af087aadc065527254da5.png); note that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/439f442d1a281ff76510cd09766962dff9fdbd65.png) can be read down to vertices $3$ or $4$.
statementZhMd:
给定一棵有 $*n*$ 个顶点的树 $*T*$（顶点编号为 $1$ 至 $*n*$），每个顶点上都有一个字母。树以顶点 $1$ 为根。

考虑某个顶点 $*v*$ 的子树 $*T*_{*v*}$。对于每一条从 $*v*$ 出发、到达 $*T*_{*v*}$ 中某个顶点的简单路径（可能到达 $*v*$ 自身），都可以沿路径读出一个字符串。将以这种方式读出的**不同**字符串的数量记为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bd208c8f291ac26d2c1afe01926632d52a3b9c7f.png)。

此外，每个顶点 $*v*$ 还被赋予一个数 $*c*_{*v*}$。我们关注 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f502ea3f6cf16bce416fd43b9c9bb79980ffa382.png) 取最大值的顶点。

你需要计算以下两个统计量：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f502ea3f6cf16bce416fd43b9c9bb79980ffa382.png) 的最大值，以及满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f502ea3f6cf16bce416fd43b9c9bb79980ffa382.png) 取最大值的顶点数量。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 300 000$）——树的顶点数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*c*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

第三行包含一个由 $*n*$ 个小写英文字母组成的字符串 $*s*$——该字符串的第 $*i*$ 个字符是顶点 $*i*$ 上的字母。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行描述树 $*T*$。每行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$（$1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$），表示顶点 $*u*$ 和顶点 $*v*$ 之间有一条边。

保证输入描述的是一棵树。

## 输出格式

输出两行。

第一行输出所有 $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$ 中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ca61e8ad8b32ae7f5adbad10109a51bd42f3ab4.png) 的最大值。

第二行输出满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6604043b6c7f1f01412e02c2d1b462b73786da81.png) 的顶点 $*v*$ 的数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，树如下所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e73c5960bdba5494ac0d005fdbeceb58e8011859.png)

从各个顶点出发可以读出的字符串集合如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cdd20e7ec866e6f991ca2f90e08792408c889db7.png)

最后，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14691bbbb07694ceb84c7c73aa24a29ecfcb9e6b.png) 的值如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/984bc948f68a2c35f75db857f62c005dcf9206d7.png)

在第二个样例中，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/58314b06b4c754bc3d1eeee1a5f0140ed5645015.png) 的值为 $(5, 4, 2, 1, 1, 1)$。在 $*T*_{2}$ 中可以读出的不同字符串为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/072d38bb85cddb83248af087aadc065527254da5.png)；注意，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/439f442d1a281ff76510cd09766962dff9fdbd65.png) 可以沿路径读到顶点 $3$ 或顶点 $4$。
